instructions.name: Merge conflict resolution before uploading
instructions.use_when: When encountering merge conflicts before uploading code
instructions.content: Always resolve merge conflicts with the main branch before uploading.

instructions.name: Shell script checks for environment variable changes in kalakosh repositories
instructions.use_when: Whenever an environment variable change happens on kalakosh repositories
instructions.content: Always check the shell scripts on the web server.

instructions.name: CI/CD tool preference based on GitHub budget
instructions.use_when: When configuring CI/CD pipelines and managing GitHub budget
instructions.content: Prioritize GitHub Actions and GitHub Compute for CI/CD. Only use Codemagic and CircleCI when the GitHub budget is low.

instructions.name: GitHub authentication method for CI/CD
instructions.use_when: When configuring GitHub authentication for CI/CD workflows
instructions.content: Always use GitHub mcp/cli/PAT for authentication instead of the browser.

instructions.name: GitHub branch protection setup
instructions.use_when: When setting up GitHub branch protection
instructions.content: Set up GitHub branch protection using the provided personal access token.

instructions.name: Preferred folder name for repository instructions
instructions.use_when: When encountering a '.claude' folder containing repository-specific instructions
instructions.content: The user prefers to rename the '.claude' folder to '.manus' or a similar descriptive name for future reference and convenience.

instructions.name: CI/CD build upload for kalakosh repositories using Codemagic
instructions.use_when: When configuring CI/CD for kalakosh repositories using Codemagic
instructions.content: Ensure that all kalakosh repositories upload their iOS and Android builds whenever the CI/CD step is run with Codemagic.

instructions.name: GitHub budget overrun handling for PRs
instructions.use_when: When the GitHub budget is over and there are open Pull Requests (PRs)
instructions.content: Ensure that an exceeded GitHub budget does not block Pull Requests (PRs).

instructions.name: CI/CD workflow for merge approvals
instructions.use_when: When handling CI builds and merge processes for code changes
instructions.content: Ensure that CI builds and checks are run only after a merge has been approved by reviewers. The branch should only be merged if CI tests and checks are successful; otherwise, the pull request (PR) should remain open. Additionally, CI/CD tests should not run at every commit, but only before the actual merge.
